quotes.text: I think that the mistake organizations make is treating agentic AI like it's just another productivity feature or roll out. This isn't a new version of Word and PowerPoint.

quotes.text: My argument is that you have higher risk when you have that lockdown because what are people doing? They're sending those same files or several versions of it via email, unsecured, now you have zero control over it.

quotes.speaker: Christian Buckley

takeaways: Agentic AI is a governance and operational transformation, not just another productivity feature, because AI instantly surfaces every permission problem across SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive.
AI readiness starts with the fundamentals: discover the sprawl, clean up content and permissions, then put guardrails such as templates, labels, lifecycle and external sharing reviews in place.
Governance works best when business units own their information, champions spread best practices and policies run in the background so people can collaborate freely within guardrails.
hook: Most Microsoft 365 governance policies were written before AI agents could find, summarize and act on everything users can access. In this conversation, MVP and Regional Director Christian Buckley shows admins, governance leads and IT decision makers how to rethink permissions, content cleanup and guardrails so Copilot and agents can scale safely.
